miniboone.reason: The local entry covers MiniBooNE as a whole. INSPIRE has separate neutrino, antineutrino, and later operating-mode records; no one mode is assigned as the whole experiment.

minos.reason: The local entry groups MINOS and MINOS+. Keep their records separate. FNAL-E-0934 is a veto-shield subproject and is not the identity of the whole MINOS experiment.

d0.reason: The local DØ entry describes the experiment across its history. INSPIRE has distinct Run I and Run II records, so a one-record identity would silently narrow its scope.

legend-200.reason: The INSPIRE record is for the broader LEGEND programme. The local LEGEND-200 detector phase must not be equated with the whole programme.
